mapper.select: SELECT cm.milestone_id AS milestoneId, cm.contract_id AS contractId, cm.step_order AS stepOrder, cm.milestone_name AS milestoneName, cm.amount AS amount, cm.due_date AS dueDate, cm.status AS status, u.name AS freelancerName FROM projects p INNER JOIN project_applications pa ON p.project_id = pa.project_id INNER JOIN contracts c ON pa.application_id = c.contract_id INNER JOIN contract_milestones cm ON c.contract_id = cm.contract_id INNER JOIN users u ON pa.freelancer_id = u.user_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY cm.step_order ASC
